security_audit.summary: This is a benign educational skill derived from Anthropic's official Claude Cookbooks repository. It provides documentation, code examples, and a reference memory-tool implementation. All 19 static findings were adjudicated as false positives: the flagged patterns are standard documentation snippets (the official uv installer command, git clone URLs, .env setup steps, os.environ API-key reads) and error-message strings, none of which are executed by the skill. The only executable code (scripts/memory_tool.py) is the official memory-tool reference implementation with robust path-traversal validation confining all filesystem operations to a /memories sandbox. No semantic findings, prompt injection, or data-exfiltration intent were detected. The SKILL.md frontmatter is invalid only because a 'TRANSLATED CONTENT:' line precedes the YAML delimiter; the content itself is safe.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md has invalid frontmatter: a 'TRANSLATED CONTENT:' line appears on line 1, before the opening '---' YAML delimiter, so the metadata block cannot be parsed.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the leading 'TRANSLATED CONTENT:' line (and the same prefix line at the top of other files) so the YAML frontmatter begins on line 1 with '---'. This will allow automated scanning of the metadata.

remediation.issue: The documented setup uses a pipe-to-shell installer command (curl ... | sh) for the uv package manager in references/CONTRIBUTING.md.
remediation.suggestion: This is the vendor-documented install method and is safe as documentation, but consider offering the Homebrew alternative (already present) as the primary recommendation, or pin the installer to a specific version for reproducibility.

content.user_title: Learn the Claude API with Official Cookbooks
content.value_statement: Developers often struggle to find current, working code patterns for the Claude API across tool use, vision, and RAG. This skill gives Claude a curated reference of official Anthropic cookbook examples and best practices so it can produce accurate, up-to-date integration code.
actual_capabilities: Provides reference documentation for core Claude API usage, including message creation and model selection.
Explains tool use and function calling with tool schema definitions and example workflows.
Covers multimodal features such as image analysis and vision-based document processing.
Describes retrieval augmented generation patterns using vector databases and semantic search.
Includes a working, sandboxed reference implementation of the Claude memory tool.
Documents performance practices such as prompt caching and cost optimization.
limitations: This skill is documentation and reference material; it does not run the Claude API or execute network calls on your behalf.
Some model identifiers in the examples may age as Anthropic releases newer models.
The included memory tool is a reference implementation and must be reviewed before production use.
It does not provide an API key; you must supply your own Claude API credentials.

use_cases.title: Onboard a new Claude API developer
use_cases.description: A developer new to the Claude API uses the skill to learn how to send messages, define tools, and structure requests correctly.
use_cases.target_user: Developers new to the Claude API

use_cases.title: Add tool use to an application
use_cases.description: An engineer building an assistant references the tool-use examples to define tool schemas and handle function-calling workflows.

use_cases.title: Build a document analysis feature
use_cases.description: A product team implements image and document analysis by following the multimodal vision patterns in the skill.

prompt_templates.title: Basic message request
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the Claude Cookbooks skill, show me how to send a simple message to the Claude API in Python.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner sending a first Claude API request.

prompt_templates.title: Define a tool
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the Claude Cookbooks skill, help me define a weather lookup tool and call it from a Claude message.
prompt_templates.scenario: Adding a first tool to a Claude integration.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an image
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the Claude Cookbooks skill, write Python code that sends an image to Claude and asks it to describe the contents.

prompt_templates.title: Build a RAG pipeline with caching
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the Claude Cookbooks skill, design a retrieval augmented generation pipeline that uses prompt caching to reduce cost on repeated context.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced developer optimizing a production RAG system.

output_examples.input: Show me how to send a simple message to the Claude API.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that you create an Anthropic client, then call the messages endpoint with a model name, a token limit, and a list of messages. It walks through each required field and describes how to read the text response.

output_examples.input: How do I let Claude call a function to get the weather?
output_examples.output: The skill describes defining a tool with a name, description, and input schema, passing the tool to the message request, and handling the tool call that Claude returns. It notes how to send the tool result back to continue the conversation.

best_practices: Read your API key from an environment variable instead of writing it directly in code.
Choose the model that fits the task, balancing speed, cost, and capability.
Use prompt caching for large, repeated context to reduce cost and latency.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode your API key in source files or commit it to version control.
Do not copy example model identifiers without checking that they are still current.
Do not use the reference memory tool in production without reviewing its path validation and access controls.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It gives Claude a curated reference of official Anthropic cookbook examples and best practices for building with the Claude API.

faq.question: Does the skill run the Claude API for me?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation and reference code. You still call the Claude API yourself using your own credentials.

faq.question: Do I need my own API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill does not provide credentials. You must supply your own Claude API key to run any examples.

faq.question: What topics does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers basic API usage, tool use and function calling, multimodal vision, retrieval augmented generation, prompt caching, and advanced agent patterns.

faq.question: Is the included memory tool safe to use?
faq.answer: The memory tool is a reference implementation with path validation that confines file operations to a sandbox directory. Review it before using it in production.

faq.question: Where does the content come from?
faq.answer: The material is derived from the official Anthropic Claude Cookbooks repository, adapted into a skill format.
